text_block_list.text:
“......Uh-oh.
Nobody's read the family LANE yet....”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You

(Dad and Mom... everyone's been so busy lately,
they said they didn't even have time to check their phones...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if she's alright...
I hope she isn't pushing herself too hard—)
